Name: Wild Flowers
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
With this mod installed, every day there is a chance for grass tiles (default 0.5% per tile) to produce seasonal wild crop flowers that you can pick like ordinary flowers.

Vanilla crop flowers include the following:

[list]
[*]Tulip (Spring)
[*]Blue Jazz (Spring)
[*]Poppy (Summer)
[*]Sunflower (Summer, Fall)
[*]Fairy Rose (Fall)
[/list]
When determining which type of flower will grow, by default flower price is used to partially determine flower rarity. You can disable this or make flower price fully determine flower rarity in the config.

Wild flowers will be considered for honey types by default (can turn off in config).

The mod apparently works with some modded flowers as well; they have to add an entry to [b]Data/Objects[/b] to be found. To disallow any flower from spawning, there is a [b]disallowList[/b] in the config that is a list of names from the name field in [b]Data/Objects[/b], e.g.:

[b]  "disallowNames": ["Kalpalata Lotus", "Padisarah"][/b]


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
